threats.title: Ticket access under a stolen or forged employee identity
threats.description: An attacker who defeats employee authentication reads and comments on customer support correspondence. Authentication is documented as delegated entirely to the enterprise OpenID Connect provider, which also owns the factor policy; the portal itself holds no accounts or credentials to attack locally.
preconditions: an attacker holds or forges an employee identity accepted by the identity provider
attack_path: obtain an employee identity at the identity provider
authenticate to the portal with it
threats.impact: Customer support correspondence is read or altered under a false identity.

threats.title: Direct access to the ticket service bypassing the portal
threats.description: The ticket service is stated to be reachable only from the portal inside the application subnet, but how that restriction is enforced — network policy or assumed topology — is not described. A workload elsewhere on the network that can reach the service would bypass the portal's authenticated path entirely.
preconditions: the stated reachability restriction is not enforced by network policy
attack_path: reach the application subnet from elsewhere on the corporate network
threats.impact: Ticket data is reachable without the portal's authenticated path.
